nodes.label: Local Search Benchmarks 10k/100k (8 May 2026, postgres-v1)
nodes.rationale: 100k queries stay under initial thresholds (filtered list <300ms, ranked q <500ms); results are indicative, dependent on local machine, DB cache and synthetic dataset; 1M limit test deferred until margin needs measuring.

nodes.label: Geography GiST Expression Indexes (migration 0013_elite_juggernaut.sql)
nodes.rationale: First smoke benchmark showed location_point::geography casts bypassed the existing geometric index causing sequential scans; migration 0013 adds GiST expression indexes on location_point::geography for listings and listing_search_documents, after which the geo plan uses a Bitmap Index Scan.
